    Both members of the 1970s soft-rock duo Seals and Crofts have passed away. Dash Crofts died on March 25, 2026, at age 87 in Austin, Texas, from heart failure. His partner, Jim Seals, died on June 6, 2022, at age 79 or 80 following a chronic illness. They are best known for hits like "Summer Breeze." 
    Dash Crofts (died March 25, 2026) 
    • Age: 87
    • Cause: Heart failure.
    • Details: Passed away in a hospital in Austin, Texas, as confirmed by his daughter, Lua Crofts Faragher. 
    Jim Seals (died June 6, 2022) 
    • Age: 79–80 (sources vary between June 6, 2022, at 79 or 80)
    • Cause: Undisclosed chronic illness.
    • Details: Passed away at his home near Nashville, Tennessee. 
    The duo, known for hits including "Diamond Girl" and "Get Closer," were childhood friends who rose to fame in the 1970s before parting ways in 1980.

    What is the controversy with Seals and Croft?
